score_breakdown.reason: USD 241.96–1224.36/month versus budget 150: fit 5 when upper bound fits, 3 when only lower fits, 1 within twice budget, otherwise 0. All selected services are included under disclosed assumptions.
Language familiarity 5.00/5 and implementation-complexity rubric 3.00/5; short delivery/beginner-complexity and manual Markdown-conversion penalties are explicit heuristics.
Static delivery avoids application writes; embedded-writer and growth triggers are ordinal review heuristics, not published capacity limits.
No latency SLA or measured framework throughput is credited; embedded-write concurrency is a review heuristic. Low-memory clients require measurement, not an assumed framework benchmark.
Operational burden 1/5+; no existing-system reuse bonus. Fewer self-operated systems are favored without DevOps. Additional service operating penalty 0.
Baseline configured controls: 3; explicit reviewed tenant isolation: 4. No certification/audit credit is assigned.

tradeoffs: Data model, backup policy, licensing and release/driver compatibility need explicit review.

warnings.message: MSG91 OTP is proposed provisionally: end-to-end india data residency is NOT established. Verify tenant/merchant eligibility, processing, logs, backups, delivery partners and contracts before production. This warning is an explicit exception to verified residency, not approval.

Razorpay Checkout is proposed provisionally: end-to-end india data residency is NOT established. Verify tenant/merchant eligibility, processing, logs, backups, delivery partners and contracts before production. This warning is an explicit exception to verified residency, not approval.
99.9% is a target, not a product guarantee. The cost model provisions redundancy assumptions; service terms, failover and workload behavior still require verification.
Infrastructure estimate USD 241.96–1224.36/month exceeds the USD 150 budget at the lower bound; this is an explicitly over-budget plan, with no requirement silently relaxed.

The output proposes technical control designs only. It does not certify compliance, establish legal applicability, execute contracts, or replace an audit. Implement controls and obtain scope-specific review.
No measured evidence establishes the 500 ms p95 target; load-test the complete client/network/data path.

Planning bands combine published reference rates and explicitly authored allowances; they are not regional provider quotes or measured workload capacity. Validate sizing, merchant/SMS eligibility, storage, requests and current tariffs before purchase.
